name: Vasudeva Kanva
role: Emperor of Magadha from 75 to 66 BCE
contribution: The founder of the Kanva dynasty.

checks.lead: Vasudeva Kanva (c. 75 – c. 66 BCE) was the founder of the Kanva dynasty. He was originally an Amatya (minister) of last Shunga ruler Devabhuti. Vasudeva killed the last Shunga ruler and established Kanva dynasty. Bana's Harshacharita informs us that he came to power after the death of Devabhuti.  He was succeeded by his son Bhumimitra.
